Question: assalam-o-aleikum mufti sahab, i have completed my engineering this yr & i did "istikhara" regarding what to do now as i was confused. and in dream i saw that i was on the edge of a house's first floor and could have fell down from the house. then i managed to get into the house, i sat down there and i saw a girl, she was very excited to see me. then a man entered into the house and that girl got very angry after seeing him but didnt speak a word. then he ate something in the house and went to wash hands in between this that girl tried to come close to me but that man saw her coming close to me, so he angrily went out of the house then i stopped that man and i too left with him leaving that girl behind. please throw some light on every aspect. jazakallah! Answer ID: 17104 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2073/1670/H=1430) The dream warns you that the desire for world have transgressed to some extent beyond limit. You should try to correct it, i.e. you should adopt good deeds and avoid evil deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
